ar: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِيْنَكَ وَأَمَانَتَكَ وَخَوَاتِيْمَ عَمَلِكَ
tr: Astaudi'ullaaha diinaka wa amaanataka wa khowaatiima 'amalik.
arti_id: Aku menitipkan agamamu, amanatmu dan penutup amalmu kepada Allah.
arti_en: May Allah provide you with piety, forgive your sins, and facilitate goodness for you wherever you are.
src: HR. At-Tirmidzi 2/7, At-Tirmidzi 5/499, dan lihat Shahih At-Tirmidzi 2/155. - Sumber: Hisnul Muslim.
